name: Lehua
nameOrigin: From the Metrosideros polymorpha also known as the ʻōhiʻa lehua

abilities.name: Fire
abilities.description: Slightly warmer than the average mon. Can tolerate fire, and swim in magma.

abilities.name: Surface Tension
abilities.description: Lehua can run at incredible speeds, allowing him to sprint across the surface of water or other liquids without sinking. However, he must keep moving to stay afloat. If he slows down too much or stops, he will sink into the water.

abilities.name: Desolate Land
abilities.description: It creates extremely harsh sunlight that prevents Water-type moves from working while the Pokémon is on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Stubborn Defiance
abilities.description:
When this Pokémon’s stats are lowered by an opponent, the stat drop is reversed into a boost instead.
Additionally, whenever this Pokémon uses a move, it clears all entry hazards and terrain effects from the battlefield.

moves.name: Precipice Blades
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokemon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in blazing flames and charges at the target with reckless speed. This move also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.description: The user attacks the opposing team wit explosive fury. The lower the user's Hp, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user rouses itself, boosting its Attack and Special Attack.
